content: actually run /pmcro-orchestrator:orchestrate run once against this new repo to prove the mint-or-link path and New-Trail.ps1 work as authored, not just as read (from the previous cycle's Reflection); plus, mid-verification: 'not sure if it should be dynamic enough to also pass a path... maybe even have an output folder, whatever you recommend'

goal: Execute New-Trail.ps1 for real (not just author it) to prove the mint path, and probe its reject paths, since this trail is itself the minted evidence of that first real mint. Add an optional scratch-output override so this kind of exercise never needs to write into live evidence again.

steps.action: run New-Trail.ps1 mint path with no -TrailId; verify folder/files/disposition shape against the documented contract
run New-Trail.ps1 with an existing -TrailId to trigger the collision reject path; verify the reported reject code matches reject.initialize.asset.md
run New-Trail.ps1 -Class A to verify the class-a-unsupported reject path

add -OutputPath to New-Trail.ps1 for scratch/testing runs that must not touch live .pmcro/trails/; document it on the command contract; re-verify all three cases plus the new path and a missing-target case

success_criteria: mint path produces exactly the documented shape
every reject case's actual message matches its documented reject code
any bug found gets fixed and re-verified in this same cycle, not deferred
out_of_scope: orchestrate run's own accept path (no live skill runtime in this session to invoke it as a command; exercised its dependency, New-Trail.ps1, directly instead)
